display_doctrine: Public casualty summaries distinguish total military deaths from hostile deaths/KIA, preserve dated snapshots, and do not convert mixed national tallies into military-only totals. Unknown is never rendered as zero unless explicitly adjudicated.

notes: The 18 figure is total U.S. military deaths across the Iran conflict, not 18 KIA.
Retain one MIA in the public summary pending an explicit formal-status resolution in the accepted casualty ledger; historical event chronology remains unchanged.
Do not sum KIA/WIA/MIA into a unique-person total without item-level deconfliction.
